decisions.reason: The comfort insole carries little investment and only a mention on the website, so commitment is weak, but it complements the core footwear range cheaply and two years is still early for a verdict.
The supportive insole fits the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution offering, so management can still attribute modest results to a temporary ramp-up and keep it at low cost.
With its own page and several models, the ergonomic series embodies substantial sunk development costs and a public commitment to the announced innovation direction, which argues for persisting.
Costly certification and long tender-based sales cycles mean results can still be read as temporary, and the sunk costs strongly favour continuing the firefighter boot line.
As the home-page flagship of the firm's direction, the moulded insole carries the strongest public commitment and need for justification, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
